title: asplenium erectum f. usambarense
intro: Asplenium erectum f. usambarense, commonly known as the Usambare Rigid Fern, is a subspecies of fern that belongs to the family Aspleniaceae. It is primarily used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe and heal various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Asplenium erectum f. usambarense include flavonoids, saponins, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
